BiblicalUsage: The felling of trees is the picture Isaiah uses for the remnant of Israel. As a teil tree and as an oak, whose substance is in them when they cast their leaves, so the holy seed shall be the substance of the land after the felling.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a felled tree still holds its substance, and the holy seed is the stump God keeps alive.
